name: Generative Syntax and Language Typology
description: This course explores how generative syntax interacts with the study of crosslinguistic variation and linguistic typology. It examines how typological generalizations can be captured within the generative framework, how parametric variation is modeled, and how empirical evidence from diverse languages informs theory-building. Students will engage with both foundational debates (e.g., universals, parameters) and contemporary approaches (e.g., cartography, comparative syntax).
